Name: Heart Symphony Set
Short description:
Four sterling silver pieces: hearts set with moissanite.

  • Four pieces: necklace, studs, bracelet, ring
  • Stamped 925 silver, lab-grown moissanite
Description:
Hearts cut clean and ringed with small stones, in sterling silver. Not sugary in the slightest. For Valentine's Day, or the day you said yes.

In the set

  • A fine chain necklace with a heart pendant in its halo
  • A pair of heart studs
  • A bracelet of set hearts, with an extension chain
  • A heart ring

Materials and finish

  • 925 sterling silver, every piece stamped 925
  • Lab-grown moissanite. Stones of 0.1 ct and above come with a GRA certificate

Give it to…
Your wife on Valentine's Day. Or your mother, who's given you plenty.

Care
Keep it dry: take your jewellery off before showering or swimming. Sterling silver darkens with air and skin contact, so store each piece in its closed pouch and buff it with the polishing cloth to bring the shine back.

The CHARMED PARIS box, included
It arrives in a blue velvet jewellery box inside the CHARMED PARIS parcel, with a velvet pouch, a polishing cloth, a care card, and the GRA certificate for stones of 0.1 ct and above. No prices anywhere in the parcel. One box per order: with two sets, the second travels in a sealed bag.

Delivery
Shipped by DHL from our partner warehouses outside the EU (United States or China). Delivered in 4 to 9 business days to France, Germany and Spain for 9 parcels in 10. Duties and import taxes are already paid: nothing to pay on arrival.
